title: CTO evening wrapup & priorities
body:
Evening quick capture — clear my head before tomorrow. Raw, noisy.

Topline / mood:
- Day felt heavy on incidents (see SRE postmortem draft). Good triage by on-call, but need clearer escalation path for 99th%-latency regressions.
- Product team really energized around private-deploy PoC (customer A). We need a tighter rollout checklist.

Tonight's quick wins (do / delegate):
- [ ] Send updated canary rollout checklist to product & SRE (short email + attach checklist). Owner: Maya (30m).
- [x] Review PR for kv-cache optimization — commented inline (done).
- [ ] Confirm Dedicated capacity pricing note for finance (Rajiv) — pinged in #finance-ops.
- [ ] Add two Qs for board-ready infra slide: fallback SLAs, expected per-token cost delta for quantized models. Owner: Maya.

Meetings to follow up on (tomorrow):
- 09:00 — Weekly Eng Exec sync (prep: status on infra incidents, top 3 risks).
- 11:00 — Customer A PoC deep-dive (bring rollout checklist + networking diagram).
- 15:00 — Growth/product sync (ask about latency SLOs for hosted tiers).

Open incident notes (triage):
- 2026-03-13 13:20 — sudden 3x tail latency on hosted-api us-west. Root cause: degraded kernel fallback on a specific GPU image. Short-term: roll back to previous image in pool. Mid-term: add regression test in CI for kernel fallback. Action owners: SRE (Rajiv) + Runtime (Lin). Linked ticket: INF-2145.

Weekly goals (top-level, keep concise):
- Lock down Private deployment minimum checklist by end of week. (what I want: network diagrams, KMS flow, upgrade playbook, logging/audit sample).
- Decide quantization support matrix by Friday (which models + supported hardware).
- Reduce hosted-api p99 by 20ms via batcher tuning experiments.

Dependencies / asks for other leaders:
- Product (Cassandra): finalize customer A's acceptance criteria for PoC (networking & perf).
- Finance (Lina): refresh Dedicated commit tiers and projected gross margin at different utilization points. Need numbers by Thu.
- Legal (Sophie): confirm terms needed for on-prem demo contracts (esp. data residency clause).

Notes to self / voice memos:
- Keep one-pager on fallback policies to under 1 page — ops-focused.
- When we pitch Private to regulated customer, emphasize unified API and audit logs. Avoid deep infra jargon in initial deck.

Parking lot (lower priority):
- Explore small FTE hiring for perf tooling (2-3 month contract).
- Quick spike: model compilation latency profiling tool (could be internal hackweek).

Quick handoffs for morning inbox:
- Rajiv: finish incident postmortem draft, include timeline + mitigation plan (expected Monday).
- Lin: schedule perf experiment 3 in staging (batch sizes, kv-cache configs) and share metric dashboard link.

Questions to answer tomorrow (top 3):
1) Do we accept limited-availability Private PoC that requires on-call support from Redwood for first 30 days? Pros/cons.
2) If we push a quantized model to Dedicated, what is expected customer-visible latency shift? (need an estimate range).
3) What guardrails do we add to automatic fallback so customer requests aren’t silently downgraded without notice?

Endnote: sleep on board slide wording. Keep it crisp — avoid technical drift.

Timestamp: 2026-03-13 20:45 (local).

----
Meta: quick capture so I can clear inbox. Will prune into Confluence + tickets tomorrow morning.
